solver_contract: Shared native solver is generated by the active longitudinal MPC with terminal speed, acceleration and distance constraints; stock runtime applies its unchanged constraint penalties at all N+1 stages

plannerd.py.adaptation: Only planner/MPC import paths redirected; no arithmetic/state/publisher changes. BOSCH-A HOOK: reads the BoschAStockBrakeFeel/BoschAHumanFollowing toggles once at start (bosch_a_toggles.read_toggles) and passes them to LongitudinalPlanner(bosch_a=...)

planner.py.adaptation: Only planner/MPC import paths redirected; no arithmetic/state/publisher changes when both Bosch-A toggles are off (bit-identical, test_bosch_a_toggles). BOSCH-A HOOK 1/3 (__init__): arms HumanFollowing/HumanAcceleration and the Stock Brake Feel enhancement only when the toggle is on and the car is a verified Bosch-A Honda with openpilot longitudinal (lazy imports). HOOK 2/3 (before mpc.update): HumanAcceleration cap and model lead paths passed to the MPC. HOOK 3/3 (after output_should_stop, before the final clip): min with the HumanAcceleration cap, then honda_bosch_a_long step() BOSCH-A SMOOTH: bosch_a_smooth.BoschASmooth (Bosch-A Hondas only, always on) shortens action_t to min(0.30, delay+DT_MDL) and applies a brake release limit + 2-tick dwell to output_a_target before the final clip

mpc.py.adaptation: Stock tuning and planner arithmetic unchanged; apply stock slack penalties at terminal stage for the shared constrained native solver. BOSCH-A HOOKs (keyword-only update args, default None = stock): lead_paths replaces a lead's raw extrapolation; acceleration_max replaces ACCEL_MAX only if finite and within [0, ACCEL_MAX]
